defect: with its run directory deleted, a finished story runs again onto the branch that already holds its finished work: every stage does its job, the run reports success, and the story's own commit changes nothing

reproduction.move: finish the story, delete the run directory, run the story again
reproduction.why_it_cannot_be_rerun: the recovered coordinator runs against today's workflow, in which `clean_clone` is an object-valued declaration rather than a string, and raises TypeError before reaching the behaviour it was recovered to show

what_holds_now.evidence_it_uses: a commit whose subject is completion_commit_subject(story_id, title) and whose body carries COMPLETION_COMMIT_MARKER
